A layout table renders its rows as list items, and those markers honour the bullets option like any other list

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var optionsJson = "{\"bullets\":\"*+-\"}";
        var options = JsonUtil.fromJson(optionsJson, ConversionOptions.class);
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<table><tr><td>alpha</td><td>beta</td></tr><tr><td><a href=\"/1\">a</a></td><td><a href=\"/2\">b</a></td><td><a href=\"/3\">c</a></td></tr></table>", options);
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
